United States.title: US Federal Judge Blocks Biden's Debt Relief Plan Due to Lack of Congressional Approval
United States.summary: A US federal judge blocked President Joe Biden's debt relief plan, citing a lack of congressional approval. The plan aimed to cancel up to $20,000 in student loan debt for millions of American borrowers. The decision has significant implications for the US economy and the Biden administration's policies.

United States.title: US House Passes Bill to Extend National Defense Authorization Act
United States.summary: The US House of Representatives passed a bill to extend the National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA). The bill aims to provide funding for the US military and support national defense efforts. The move is seen as a step towards maintaining US military strength and stability.

United States.title: US Attorney General Merrick Garland Tests Positive for COVID-19
United States.summary: US Attorney General Merrick Garland has tested positive for COVID-19. Garland is undergoing treatment and has assured that he will continue to oversee the Department of Justice's operations remotely. The development comes at a critical time for the US, with ongoing investigations and law enforcement efforts.

South Korea.title: North Korea fires missiles into the Sea of Japan: South Korea and Japan
South Korea.summary: South Korea and Japan detected multiple ballistic missiles fired by North Korea on July 31, 2022. The missiles landed in the Sea of Japan without causing any damage or injuries. The incident heightened tensions in the region and raised concerns about North Korea's military activities.

South Korea.title: South Korea reports record number of Covid-19 cases among the fully vaccinated
South Korea.summary: South Korea reported a record number of Covid-19 cases among the fully vaccinated population on August 1, 2022. The surge in cases has raised concerns about the effectiveness of vaccines and the need for booster shots.

South Korea.title: South Korean parliament approves bill to revise the national security law
South Korea.summary: The National Assembly of South Korea passed a bill to revise the national security law on July 28, 2022. The revised law aims to strengthen the country's national security and counter threats from North Korea and other adversaries.

Japan.title: North Korea conducts missile tests
Japan.summary: North Korea's latest missile tests have raised concerns over its nuclear capabilities and Japan's neighboring security.

Japan.title: Japan's parliament approves state of emergency extension in Tokyo and surrounding areas
Japan.summary: The Japanese government has extended a state of emergency in Tokyo and surrounding areas to combat COVID-19, affecting residents and businesses.

Japan.title: Tokyo confirms record high COVID-19 cases, straining hospitals and healthcare resources
Japan.summary: Tokyo's record high COVID-19 cases have put pressure on local hospitals and healthcare resources, exacerbating the ongoing pandemic challenges.
